payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed models can effectively capture dialog context with a turn size of 3 and 5, suggesting that dialog history is modeled over multiple turns.

claims.text: The proposed models capture dialog history effectively with a turn size of 3 and 5.
The maximum turn length in the evaluation dataset is set to 160.
The models utilize the last RNN state of turn k-1 as context for turn k, indicating a multi-turn dialog history approach.
